shortDescription: Manages PostgreSQL hostgroup attributes using the ProxySQL admin interface

options.name: autocommit
options.description: Not yet implemented (as per ProxySQL documentation).

options.name: comment
options.description: Text field that can be used for any purposes defined by the user.

options.name: config_file
options.description: Specify a config file from which I(login_user) and I(login_password) are to be read.

options.name: connection_warming
options.description: Whether ProxySQL will be opening new connections until the expected number of warm connections is reached.

options.name: free_connections_pct
options.description: The percentage of open idle connections for each server in a hostgroup.

options.name: hostgroup_id
options.description: ID of the hostgroup.

options.name: hostgroup_settings
options.description: Override certain global configurations.

options.name: ignore_session_variables
options.description: Not yet implemented (as per ProxySQL documentation).

options.name: init_connect
options.description: Semicolon-delimited string of SQL statements to be executed for each back-end connection when initialized.

options.name: load_to_runtime
options.description: Dynamically load config to runtime memory.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The host used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_unix_socket
options.description: The socket used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: max_num_online_servers
options.description: Prevents new connections when the number of ONLINE servers in the hostgroup exceeds this number.

options.name: multiplex
options.description: Enables or disables multiplexing for the specific hostgroup.

options.name: save_to_disk
options.description: Save config to sqlite db on disk to persist the configuration.

options.name: servers_defaults
options.description: Provide default values for discovered servers.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present) - adds the hostgroup attributes, when C(absent) - removes the hostgroup attributes.

options.name: throttle_connections_per_sec
options.description: Maximum number of new connections that can be opened per second.
